en.headline: HKMCA authorises BOC Life intermediaries to refer annuity plan
en.dek: Designated licensed insurance intermediaries of BOC Group Life Assurance may now introduce the HKMC Annuity Plan to customers and refer eligible clients under a new partnership announced Friday.
body: HKMC Annuity Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation, announced on Friday that, building on its strategic partnership with BOC Group Life Assurance Company Limited, designated licensed insurance intermediaries of BOC Life are authorised to introduce the HKMC Annuity Plan to their customers and refer eligible clients to the HKMCA.

Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer of the HKMCA, Daniel Leong, said the collaboration allows more licensed intermediaries to help the public understand the role of the annuity plan in retirement planning. The HKMCA looks forward to working with more institutions to help people achieve long-term sustainable retirement goals.
The HKMCA reminded the public that enquiries or verification of designated intermediaries can be made through its customer service hotline.

zh.headline: 年金公司與中銀人壽合作 授權中介介紹年金計劃
zh.dek: 香港按揭證券有限公司全資附屬的年金公司周五公布，中銀人壽指定持牌保險中介可向客戶介紹年金計劃並轉介合資格客戶。
body: 香港按揭證券有限公司全資附屬的香港年金有限公司周五公布，在與中銀集團人壽保險有限公司的策略合作下，中銀人壽的指定持牌保險中介獲授權向客戶介紹香港年金計劃，並轉介合資格客戶至年金公司。
年金公司執行董事兼行政總裁梁永禮表示，與中銀人壽的合作讓更多持牌中介協助公眾了解年金計劃在退休規劃中的角色，期望與更多機構合作，協助市民達致長遠可持續的退休目標。
市民如有查詢或核實指定中介身份，可致電年金公司客戶服務熱線。
